steps.message: Quantos chamados foram abertos em agosto de 2026 pela requisitante Vanessa Nascimento?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(requester)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Vanessa Nascimento'));
SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(requester)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Vanessa Nascimento')) ORDER BY ticket;
